data.name: Niam
data.gender_notes: Niam is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-m' meaning 'to be kind, benevolent'. The name Niam signifies grace, beauty, and kindness, making it an elegant choice for a baby girl in the Islamic community. The name Niam carries the meaning “Grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Niam usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies grace and kindness, reflecting the beautiful qualities of Allah (swt) and His messenger (saaws).
data.etymology: Niam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Niam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
